history.summary: A 474 sqft 1BR at $2,025 psf sits ~10% below Alex Residences' verified 2025 resale mean (~$2,243 psf, 26 deals), in a Redhill-MRT-fronting RCR project with deep transaction support — a real, web-confirmed entry discount.
history.rating_rationale: At $960k / 474 sqft ($2,025 psf) this is below the project's 2025 mean of ~$2,243 psf (26 resale transactions) and below the trailing 6-12 month average ~$2,240-$2,257 psf. Because it is the smallest unit type, the relevant benchmark is its own cohort, and the algo backs the cheapness with real depth — appreciation_txns=111 and psf_cohort_txns=6 — so unlike Radix/77 this discount is not a thin-data quirk. D3 (RCR) carries a respectable forward realized drift (~+3.5%, well above CCR's ~+0.7%), and the unit is directly above/next to Redhill MRT (EWL) with the Greater Southern Waterfront and Alexandra rejuvenation as longer-dated tailwinds. Small 1BR is the most liquid, most rentable format. Trailing 3.79% CAGR is treated as story only. Verified cheap vs real recent comps plus a strong location supports Buy; capped at medium confidence because the discount is moderate (~10%) and the model explains <10% of forward variance.
red_flags: 99-yr lease from ~2014; lease decay over a 5-7yr hold is a mild drag
1BR-heavy stack (87 of 429 units) means competing supply on resale/rental
Discount is moderate (~10%), not a deep bargain
catalysts: Directly beside Redhill MRT (EWL) — strong rental and resale liquidity
Greater Southern Waterfront / Alexandra-Redhill rejuvenation corridor
Smallest, most liquid unit type — easy exit and steady tenant demand
